Hong Kong pitched a gold-hub vision at the London Bullion Market Association's annual meeting in Italy this week — and Singapore pitched a rival one from the same stage. At stake: a share of the 39,000 tonnes central banks hold worldwide.

許正宇本週在意大利出席倫敦金銀市場協會（LBMA）年會，向業界推銷香港的黃金樞紐大計；新加坡金管局代表林清凱同場提出競爭方案。雙方爭奪的，是全球央行合共持有約39,000噸黃金的份額。

Hong Kong's gold trade is watching its biggest customer keep buying. China's central bank added to its gold reserves for a 23rd straight month in September — even as the reserves' dollar value fell as prices dropped.

香港金飾業界正密切留意最大買家的動向：中國人民銀行9月連續第23個月增持黃金。儲備量雖增，但受金價跌逾6%拖累，儲備總值由8月底的3,500.8億美元，跌至9月底的3,235.2億美元。
